note: Every game system the mashup touches. One row = one code module. 'natives' lists names that MUST exist in sheets/natives.json (preflight enforces it). 'steps' is the behavior contract the test pass verifies in game.

rows.trigger: ASI loaded by Ultimate ASI Loader at game start
steps: open log file {localappdata}/ArthurContracts/log.txt (create dir)
pattern-scan get_native_address, update_single_scripts (tick), current_script_thread; fall back to is_dlc_present tick if primary sig not found
install MinHook detours; on each tick run contract_flow.update()
every native call wrapped in SEH; on pattern miss log and keep game running
rows.verify: log.txt contains RESOLVED lines for all patterns after first launch

steps: read C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\libraryfolders.vdf, find app 1659040, resolve HITMAN 3 folder
if not found: set hitmanInstalled=false and show missing_notice (see briefing_menu step 7)
open Runtime\chunk0.rpkg + all chunk*.rpkg indexes (header parse only, no full read)
for each hc_* row: ioiHash = md5(ioiPath)[1:8] big-endian; find the chunk containing it; extract+decompress the JSON resource
parse Metadata (CodeName_Hint, Location, TileImage) and Data.Objectives._comment -> target display names
cache parsed result in {localappdata}/ArthurContracts/hitman_cache.json
rows.verify: cache file contains codename Rat/Bulldog/Llama and target names Hush/The Archivist/Alexa Carlisle/The Winemaker/The Herald/Diana Burnwood on this PC (recon already proved these exist)

rows.trigger: after loading into story mode (world ready) and on key H when idle
steps: draw HITMAN-style dossier overlay: title with HITMAN codename, location line, target list from hitman_reader, briefLine
three contract tabs navigated with Left/Right (control ids from natives sheet usage constants), Enter (control) accepts, Esc/H closes
draw with VAR_STRING(10,'LITERAL_STRING',...) + HUD _DISPLAY_TEXT + _SET_TEXT_COLOR; panels with GRAPHICS DRAW_RECT; scale via UIDEBUG _BG_SET_TEXT_SCALE fallback if HUD scale unavailable
if hitmanInstalled=false: show 'HITMAN World of Assassination not found - contract files unavailable' instead of tabs
rows.verify: screenshot of dossier screen with real HITMAN codenames visible

steps: states: IDLE -> BRIEFING_OPEN -> ACCEPTED -> ACTIVE -> COMPLETE -> RATING -> (back to IDLE)
ACCEPTED: grant weapons.json kit, spawn targets (spawning), start timer, enable detection_instinct + scoring
ACTIVE: target death counts down objective list; all primary targets dead -> COMPLETE
COMPLETE: show rating screen for 8s (scoring result), then despawn everything and return IDLE
player death during ACTIVE -> contract failed notice -> despawn -> IDLE
rows.verify: accept contract in game: weapons granted, peds spawn, kill both targets, rating appears

steps: REQUEST_MODEL for each row's modelCandidate until HAS_MODEL_LOADED (try candidates in order; log which loaded)
CREATE_PED at spawnCoords + spawnOffset with heading + headingOffset
give weaponRef weapon if set (guards), SET_BLOCKING_OF_NON_TEMPORARY_EVENTS true for scripted behaviors
contract_llama: CREATE_VEHICLE wagon candidate model at spawnCoords; driver takes seat 0, Winemaker seat 1, Herald seat 2; TASK_VEHICLE_DRIVE_WANDER for driver
SET_ENTITY_AS_MISSION_ENTITY on everything so it despawns cleanly
rows.verify: every spawned entity exists (DOES_ENTITY_EXIST) for 30s during ACTIVE; none leak after despawn

steps: per contract ped: if dist < seeingRange and LOS clear (START_SHAPE_TEST_LOS_PROBE from ped eye to player) -> meter rises; loses LOS decays it
meter states: 0 oblivious, >0.5 'suspicious' (ped TASK_TURN_PED_TO_FACE_ENTITY), >=1.0 'alert' (TASK_COMBAT_PED on player), counted as detected for scoring
hold Instinct key (control): draw target markers at screen positions via GET_HUD_SCREEN_POSITION_FROM_WORLD_POSITION + highlight ring text; show meters over heads as '+ ? +' style text
silenced revolver mechanic: while ACTIVE, SET_PED_HEARING_RANGE 0 on contract peds (shots never trigger alert directly)
vanilla law interference is out of scope (story mode): if wanted level rises, log it; contract rules still decide scoring
rows.verify: walk at guard: meter text appears and rises; walk away: decays; reach 1.0: guard attacks; during contract, gunshots do not raise meter

steps: wander_small_loop: TASK_GO_STRAIGHT_TO_COORD between 3 nearby points every ~8s
stand_idle: TASK_STAND_STILL refreshed every 5s
walk_between_points: two anchors near the estate, walk + face
patrol_perimeter: loop of 4 points around spawn
escort_target: follow nearest target at 3m
drive_vehicle: TASK_VEHICLE_DRIVE_WANDER (set once)
coin investigate: on coin landing (sound_distract), guards within 25m TASK_GO_STRAIGHT_TO_COORD to coin position, then resume behavior
rows.verify: each behavior visibly runs in game for 30s; coin makes guards walk to it

steps: GIVE_WEAPON_TO_PED each kit row to player (ammo per row, -1 = melee), SET_CURRENT_PED_WEAPON to silenced revolver
equip order: revolver, fiber wire, throwing knives, rubber duck
on despawn: weapons stay (player keeps kit - funny and convenient)
rows.verify: wheel shows the four items with expected ammo counts

steps: track per-target health each tick (GET_ENTITY_HEALTH); on drop to <=0 mark killed by player

fiber wire takedown: if player within 1.8m behind a ped (dot of facing vectors < -0.5), next melee attack resolves as instant APPLY_DAMAGE_TO_PED 500 + SET_PED_TO_RAGDOLL short, no combat raised, no sound
record killedProtected (npc_ll_diana) and killedCivilians (any non-contract ped the player kills, sampled each tick via GET_PED_SOURCE_OF_DEATH near player)
rows.verify: back takedown kills silently (no alert); Diana kill fails contract

inputs: disguise table: contract -> outfit hash candidates
steps: contract_bulldog: equip estate-guard outfit on Arthur; contract_rat: city-look outfit; contract_llama: vineyard-hand outfit
_REQUEST_META_PED_OUTFIT then _EQUIP_META_PED_OUTFIT(playerPed, outfitHash) with candidate hashes listed in this row's outfitCandidates; keep first that reports _HAS_META_PED_OUTFIT_LOADED
disguise effect: guards' seeingRange halved while equipped (social stealth), toggled back on G
fallback if no candidate equips: notice 'This outfit is not available' and no effect (logged)
rows.verify: G visibly changes Arthur's outfit OR logs which candidates failed (sheet then updated with working hashes)

steps: top-left: contract codename + elapsed timer (VAR_STRING + _DISPLAY_TEXT)
objectives list: remaining primary targets with names from hitman_reader ('Hush - ALIVE/DEAD')
detection hint: bottom line showing current worst meter ('UNSEEN' / 'SUSPICIOUS' / 'SPOTTED')
RATING state: full HITMAN-style end card drawn with same primitives (SILENT ASSASSIN / GHOST / CAUGHT + stats lines)
rows.verify: screenshot shows codename, timer, objectives; screenshot of rating card

steps: BLIP_ADD_FOR_ENTITY on each blip=true ped with standard enemy/mission sprite; SET_BLIP_SCALE 0.9
instinct key also draws a screen marker (crosshair text) at target screen position
REMOVE_BLIP + release on despawn
rows.verify: minimap shows markers during ACTIVE and none after

rows.trigger: coin gadget used (key C throws coin object)
steps: CREATE_OBJECT p_coin01x ahead of player, physics it forward
PLAY_SOUND_FROM_ENTITY coin clink audio at object; guards within 25m walk to it (guard_ai coin investigate)
object deleted after 10s (DELETE_OBJECT)
if model or audio missing: log and fall back to a thrown throwing knife as the distract object
rows.verify: guards walk to the coin spot after throw

steps: flags: detectedAny, killedProtected, killedCivilians, usedLoudWeapons (rubber duck), timeSeconds
SILENT ASSASSIN: all primary targets dead AND !detectedAny AND !killedProtected AND !killedCivilians AND !usedLoudWeapons
GHOST: targets dead, no civilian/protected kills, but detected
CAUGHT: player died or protected target killed
result fed to hud_overlay rating card
rows.verify: force each ending in test runs: clean run -> SILENT ASSASSIN, shoot in front of guard -> GHOST, kill Diana -> CAUGHT
